milestone: Week 8 - End-to-End Demonstration and Experimental Evaluation
roadmap_scenario: Send two drones north to inspect crops and one drone east to inspect irrigation.
completion_rule: Every required stage must have stored, reproducible evidence; format-valid intermediate output alone is insufficient.
evidence_constraints: The speech stage must reference an actual WAV file and a stored ASR prediction with model provenance.
The exact roadmap command must be represented as two mission clauses requesting three drones in total.
Distinct grounded location and target references must be spatially reconciled or explicitly clarified.
Vision results must reference images assigned to this simulated mission; a Week 6 development summary alone is insufficient.
Raw outputs must remain separate from derived analysis.
Failures, unresolved inputs, package/model versions, parameters, splits, and random seeds must be retained.
No physical-flight, safety-guarantee, or novelty claim may be inferred from this software-simulation run.

thresholds.rule: Report measured values without inventing pass thresholds.
